body:
Founder real-time: "also i need another blog post any any any."

Picked GTA7's K9 Doctrine (real, shipped mechanic: sneak+right-click a tamed Wolf near a held
Field Office assigns "K9 unit" status, diminishing-returns defense score extends Contest Window
duration -- checked directly against GTA7/CLAUDE.md and docs/NORTHSTAR.md before writing). Third
genuinely distinct register today: not financial (TINA), not philosophical essay (Paimon), not
comedic multi-character dialogue (Unicorn) -- a short, clipped, non-verbal field-report voice from
a K9 unit itself. Real domain (EINHORN_SURVIVAL Minecraft server via GTA7's TRAPX doctrine),
never used as a blog voice before.

Published: https://okemily.com/blog/field-report-k9-unit/ (verified live, HTTP 200).
title: Published third blog post: Field Report from a GTA7 K9 unit
